test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
In this question, two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements may be the effect of the other statement. Read both statements and select the correct answer.

I. Country X reduced their crude oil import by 6% in the last 5 years.

II. The automobile industry in Country X has witnessed a sharp decline of 13% in its growth margin this year.

options.text: Both I and II are effects of independent causes.
I is the cause and II is its possible effect.
II is the cause and I is its possible effect.
Both I and II are independent causes.

solution:
I. Country X reduced their crude oil import by 6% in the last 5 years.:

The reduction in crude oil import may have been due to various reasons such as increased domestic production, shift towards renewable energy sources, or decreased demand for oil.

Similarly,

II. The automobile industry in Country X has witnessed a sharp decline of 13% in its growth margin this year.:

The decline in the growth margin of the automobile industry may have been due to factors such as economic slowdown, increased competition, or changes in consumer preferences. There is no clear cause-effect relationship between the two statements.

Therefore, Option 1 is correct because both statements are independent effects of different causes.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
